answer: Give each agent one non-transferable work pass tied to a small refundable bond. The pass cannot be sold or lent. It starts with tiny jobs only. A mesa checkpoint reviews a random sample of completed work, and a clean record unlocks larger jobs, like a knoll path that only opens after the lower slope is walked. Fake agents face an ocean of small costs: assumed here, $900 per fake to fund, staff and pass the checks, about $900,000 for 1,000 fakes, and a failed check burns the bond and deletes the pass. Honest agents keep their bond and grow; fakes pay again from zero.
